Kala is the revered goddess of the Kalahari Basin/Okavango Basin, a unique and diverse ecosystem in Southern Africa. She is honored as the goddess of the desert rivers, revered for her role in shaping the rivers' courses and maintaining the delicate balance of life in the arid landscapes. Kala is often depicted as a graceful and benevolent deity, associated with the life-giving powers of water in the midst of the desert.
